title: Number Plate and Document Capture at Service Centres
summary: Read number plates at the workshop gate, pull up the appointment and history from the DMS, and capture walk-around, dashboard and document photos into a pre-filled job card.

seo.title: Number Plate and Document Capture for Workshops | VipraTech
seo.description: ANPR and photo capture at service reception: read plates, match DMS appointments, record walk-around damage, odometer and fuel, and pre-fill job cards.

problem.intro: Most dealer workshops see a rush at the reception bay in the morning, when service advisors type registration numbers, look up appointments, note odometer and fuel and walk around each car with a paper checklist. Errors and shortcuts at this step follow the vehicle through the whole visit.

pain_points.title: Typing errors at reception
pain_points.detail: A mistyped registration number pulls the wrong history or creates a duplicate vehicle record in the DMS.

pain_points.title: Morning queues
pain_points.detail: Customers wait while advisors key in details that could have been read from the car itself.

pain_points.title: Pre-existing damage disputes
pain_points.detail: Without dated photos, a scratch noticed at delivery becomes an argument about whether the workshop caused it.

pain_points.title: No reliable turnaround data
pain_points.detail: Gate-in and gate-out times are entered by hand, so workshop turnaround and bay utilisation reports cannot be trusted.

solution.overview: We build a reception capture system for the workshop. An ANPR camera at the gate reads the number plate, including high-security registration plates and BH-series plates, and looks up the vehicle and any appointment in the DMS. At the reception bay, a tablet app guides the advisor through walk-around photos, a dashboard photo from which odometer, fuel level and warning lamps are read, and photos of the RC, insurance and PUC where needed. Damage marks and readings pre-fill the job card for the advisor to confirm. The customer receives the photos on WhatsApp, and a gate-out read closes the visit timestamp.
capabilities: Reads Indian number plates, including high-security registration, BH-series and two-wheeler plates
Matches plates to appointments and vehicle history in the DMS
Reads odometer, fuel level indicator and warning lamps from a dashboard photo
Guided walk-around photos with damage marks stored on the job card
Captures RC, insurance and PUC images into the vehicle file
Gate-in and gate-out timestamps for turnaround and bay utilisation reports

workflow.title: Read the plate at the gate
workflow.detail: An ANPR camera reads the plate as the vehicle enters and records the gate-in time.

workflow.title: Match in the DMS
workflow.detail: The plate is matched to the vehicle record and today's appointment; unmatched or uncertain reads go to the advisor.

workflow.title: Walk-around and dashboard capture
workflow.detail: The advisor follows the tablet guide for walk-around, dashboard and document photos.

workflow.title: Confirm the job card
workflow.detail: Odometer, fuel, warning lamps, damage marks and customer concerns pre-fill the job card, and the advisor confirms each field.

workflow.title: Share with the customer
workflow.detail: The customer receives the walk-around photos and job card summary on WhatsApp.

workflow.title: Close at gate-out
workflow.detail: A second plate read at exit closes the visit and feeds turnaround reports.

inputs: Reception tablet photos of exterior, dashboard and documents
DMS vehicle master and appointment list
Customer concerns captured by the advisor
RC, insurance and PUC images where required
outputs: Plate reads with gate-in and gate-out times
Dated walk-around photo record per visit
human_in_the_loop: The service advisor confirms the vehicle match and every pre-filled job card field before work starts. Damage marks are agreed with the customer at reception, so the photo record reflects both sides' view.
integrations: Dealer management system, OEM-supplied or third-party
guardrails: Low-confidence plate reads always go to the advisor
Gate cameras framed on plates, not faces, with footage retained only as your policy sets
Plate reads used only for the service visit and reporting
Customers can see every reception photo
Advisor edits to pre-filled fields are logged
compliance_notes: Gate signage and the job card notice explain what is captured and why, in line with notice and purpose limitation under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: One workshop's gate and reception bay, covering all service visits during the pilot, with the advisor confirming every read.
deliverables: Camera placement and reception flow design
ANPR and tablet capture live at the pilot workshop
DMS lookup and job card pre-fill
Plan for other workshops in the group

what_we_measure.how: Reads compared with advisor-confirmed registration numbers, split by day, night and plate type.
Time from gate-in to job card creation, before and during the pilot.
Share of visits with the full set of reception photos.
Count of delivery-time damage disputes logged during the pilot period.

faqs.q: What about dirty, damaged or non-standard plates?
faqs.a: Reads below the confidence threshold go to the advisor for confirmation, and the report shows accuracy by plate condition. Non-standard fonts and decorative plates are common, so we tune on footage from your gate.

faqs.q: Can we use our existing CCTV?
faqs.a: Sometimes. Plate reading needs a camera angled at plate height with suitable shutter speed and lighting, so we check your current cameras and recommend a dedicated ANPR unit where needed.

faqs.q: Does it work for two-wheeler workshops?
faqs.a: Yes. Two-wheeler plates are smaller and mounted at varied heights, so gate design matters more, and we plan camera placement accordingly.

faqs.q: Which DMS do you integrate with?
faqs.a: We work with the DMS your OEM or dealer group uses, through its APIs where available or a staging integration otherwise. The DMS remains the system of record.
